package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type TelegramRepository struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

func (repository TelegramRepository) IssueLinkCode(ctx context.Context, digest [32]byte, record domain.TelegramLinkRecord) error {
	if repository.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(record.StudentID) || !validUUIDString(record.PersonalTeacherID) ||
		!validUUIDString(record.DialogID) || record.CreatedAt.IsZero() || !record.ExpiresAt.After(record.CreatedAt) {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	tx, err := repository.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_telegram_link_code WHERE student_id=$1 AND consumed_at IS NULL`, record.StudentID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_telegram_link_code
(code_hash, student_id, personal_teacher_id, dialog_id, expires_at, created_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)`, digest[:], record.StudentID, record.PersonalTeacherID, record.DialogID,
		record.ExpiresAt.UTC(), record.CreatedAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) ConsumeLinkCode(
	ctx context.Context,
	digest [32]byte,
	telegramUserID, chatID int64,
	now time.Time,
) (domain.TelegramBinding, error) {
	if repository.Pool == nil || telegramUserID <= 0 || chatID <= 0 || now.IsZero() {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrInvalidTelegramUpdate
	}
	tx, err := repository.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	var record domain.TelegramLinkRecord
	var consumedAt *time.Time
	var consumedUserID, consumedChatID *int64
	err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT student_id, personal_teacher_id::text, dialog_id::text, expires_at, created_at,
       consumed_at, consumed_telegram_user_id, consumed_chat_id
FROM teacher_telegram_link_code WHERE code_hash=$1 FOR UPDATE`, digest[:]).Scan(
		&record.StudentID, &record.PersonalTeacherID, &record.DialogID, &record.ExpiresAt, &record.CreatedAt,
		&consumedAt, &consumedUserID, &consumedChatID,
	)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrTelegramLinkInvalid
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, err
	}
	if consumedAt != nil {
		if consumedUserID == nil || consumedChatID == nil || *consumedUserID != telegramUserID || *consumedChatID != chatID {
			return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrTelegramLinkInvalid
		}
		binding, readErr := getTelegramBindingByStudent(ctx, tx, record.StudentID)
		if readErr != nil || binding.TelegramUserID != telegramUserID || binding.ChatID != chatID {
			return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrTelegramLinkInvalid
		}
		return binding, tx.Commit(ctx)
	}
	if !record.ExpiresAt.After(now) {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrTelegramLinkInvalid
	}
	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_telegram_binding
(student_id, personal_teacher_id, dialog_id, telegram_user_id, chat_id, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$6)
ON CONFLICT (student_id) DO UPDATE SET
personal_teacher_id=EXCLUDED.personal_teacher_id, dialog_id=EXCLUDED.dialog_id,
telegram_user_id=EXCLUDED.telegram_user_id, chat_id=EXCLUDED.chat_id, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at`,
		record.StudentID, record.PersonalTeacherID, record.DialogID, telegramUserID, chatID, now.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		var postgresError *pgconn.PgError
		if errors.As(err, &postgresError) && postgresError.Code == "23505" {
			return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrTelegramLinkConflict
		}
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, err
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE teacher_telegram_link_code
SET consumed_at=$2, consumed_telegram_user_id=$3, consumed_chat_id=$4
WHERE code_hash=$1`, digest[:], now.UTC(), telegramUserID, chatID); err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, err
	}
	binding, err := getTelegramBindingByStudent(ctx, tx, record.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, err
	}
	return binding, tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) GetBindingByChat(ctx context.Context, telegramUserID, chatID int64) (domain.TelegramBinding, error) {
	if repository.Pool == nil || telegramUserID <= 0 || chatID <= 0 {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrInvalidTelegramUpdate
	}
	binding, err := scanTelegramBinding(repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT student_id, personal_teacher_id::text, dialog_id::text, telegram_user_id, chat_id, created_at, updated_at
FROM teacher_telegram_binding WHERE telegram_user_id=$1 AND chat_id=$2`, telegramUserID, chatID))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, domain.ErrTelegramBindingNotFound
	}
	return binding, err
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) EnqueueDelivery(ctx context.Context, sourceMessageID, studentID, body string, now time.Time) error {
	if repository.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(sourceMessageID) || !validUUIDString(studentID) ||
		strings.TrimSpace(body) == "" || len(body) > 48000 || now.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_telegram_delivery
(source_message_id, student_id, chat_id, body, status, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT $1, student_id, chat_id, $3, 'pending', $4, $4, $4
FROM teacher_telegram_binding WHERE student_id=$2
ON CONFLICT (source_message_id) DO NOTHING`, sourceMessageID, studentID, body, now.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() == 1 {
		return nil
	}
	var existingStudentID, existingBody string
	err = repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT student_id, body FROM teacher_telegram_delivery WHERE source_message_id=$1`, sourceMessageID).Scan(&existingStudentID, &existingBody)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.ErrTelegramBindingNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if existingStudentID != studentID || existingBody != body {
		return domain.ErrTelegramLinkConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) ClaimDelivery(ctx context.Context, claimToken string, now, lockedUntil time.Time) (domain.TelegramDelivery, bool, error) {
	if repository.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(claimToken) || now.IsZero() || !lockedUntil.After(now) {
		return domain.TelegramDelivery{}, false, domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	delivery, err := scanTelegramDelivery(repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT source_message_id FROM teacher_telegram_delivery
    WHERE ((status='pending' AND next_attempt_at <= $1) OR (status='processing' AND locked_until <= $1))
    ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at, source_message_id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE teacher_telegram_delivery delivery
SET status='processing', claim_token=$2, locked_until=$3, attempts=attempts+1, updated_at=$1
FROM candidate WHERE delivery.source_message_id=candidate.source_message_id
RETURNING delivery.source_message_id::text, delivery.student_id, delivery.chat_id, delivery.body,
          delivery.status, delivery.claim_token::text, delivery.attempts, delivery.created_at`,
		now.UTC(), claimToken, lockedUntil.UTC()))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TelegramDelivery{}, false, nil
	}
	return delivery, err == nil, err
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) MarkDeliverySent(ctx context.Context, sourceMessageID, claimToken string, remoteMessageID int64, now time.Time) error {
	if remoteMessageID <= 0 {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	return repository.finishDelivery(ctx, sourceMessageID, claimToken, `
UPDATE teacher_telegram_delivery SET status='sent', claim_token=NULL, locked_until=NULL,
remote_message_id=$3, sent_at=$4, last_error_code=NULL, updated_at=$4
WHERE source_message_id=$1 AND status='processing' AND claim_token=$2`, remoteMessageID, now)
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) RetryDelivery(ctx context.Context, sourceMessageID, claimToken, code string, retryAt, now time.Time) error {
	if !retryAt.After(now) || !validErrorCode(code) {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	return repository.finishDelivery(ctx, sourceMessageID, claimToken, `
UPDATE teacher_telegram_delivery SET status='pending', claim_token=NULL, locked_until=NULL,
next_attempt_at=$3, last_error_code=$4, updated_at=$5
WHERE source_message_id=$1 AND status='processing' AND claim_token=$2`, retryAt.UTC(), code, now)
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) BlockDelivery(ctx context.Context, sourceMessageID, claimToken, code string, now time.Time) error {
	if !validErrorCode(code) {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	return repository.finishDelivery(ctx, sourceMessageID, claimToken, `
UPDATE teacher_telegram_delivery SET status='blocked', claim_token=NULL, locked_until=NULL,
last_error_code=$3, updated_at=$4
WHERE source_message_id=$1 AND status='processing' AND claim_token=$2`, code, now)
}

func (repository TelegramRepository) finishDelivery(ctx context.Context, sourceMessageID, claimToken, query string, args ...any) error {
	if repository.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(sourceMessageID) || !validUUIDString(claimToken) {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, query, append([]any{sourceMessageID, claimToken}, args...)...)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
	}
	return nil
}

type telegramRow interface{ Scan(...any) error }

func getTelegramBindingByStudent(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, studentID string) (domain.TelegramBinding, error) {
	return scanTelegramBinding(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT student_id, personal_teacher_id::text, dialog_id::text, telegram_user_id, chat_id, created_at, updated_at
FROM teacher_telegram_binding WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID))
}

func scanTelegramBinding(row telegramRow) (domain.TelegramBinding, error) {
	var binding domain.TelegramBinding
	err := row.Scan(&binding.StudentID, &binding.PersonalTeacherID, &binding.DialogID, &binding.TelegramUserID,
		&binding.ChatID, &binding.CreatedAt, &binding.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TelegramBinding{}, err
	}
	return domain.NormalizeTelegramBinding(binding)
}

func scanTelegramDelivery(row telegramRow) (domain.TelegramDelivery, error) {
	var delivery domain.TelegramDelivery
	err := row.Scan(&delivery.SourceMessageID, &delivery.StudentID, &delivery.ChatID, &delivery.Body,
		&delivery.Status, &delivery.ClaimToken, &delivery.Attempts, &delivery.CreatedAt)
	return delivery, err
}

func validErrorCode(code string) bool {
	code = strings.TrimSpace(code)
	return code != "" && len(code) <= 64
}

var _ repository.TelegramStore = TelegramRepository{}
